audit.why: Poke-vs-poke mirror gated by root cooldown, EVEN 5.5/10, matches two cooldown-gated CC mages trading long-range pokes.
Level 2 poke spike, level 6 R out-range, first-item mana-fueled poke are already stated and consistent with the level chart.

spikes[1].text correctly notes Black Shield blocks CC but not R's true damage, matching enemyKit.E (shield flag: 'absorbs burst') and the R being trueDamage. The packet's suspectNames flag on 'Black Shield' is a false positive — that is Morgana's real E name per enemyAbilities.

edits.before: Q-fork the pair, W the pulse, third-hit the research — true math their page can't answer.
edits.after: Dark Binding is a slow, thick skillshot — sidestep it and her all-in options vanish until the roughly 10s cooldown resets.

edits.before: Beaming into a loaded engage — the channel is a verdict for fights already decided.
edits.after: Soul Shackles chains everyone nearby into one long stun — grouped with your ADC turns one landed R into a double lockdown.

edits.before: Commit on Dark Binding’s cooldown, on your first item spike, and with your carry’s damage online. Make him flinch first.
edits.after: Commit on Dark Binding’s cooldown, on your first item spike, and with your carry’s damage online. Make her flinch first.

edits.before: - Morgana Dark Binding: matchup-defining — The three-second root — minion-block it; the pool follows wherever it lands. The duo’s tempo bends around it. - Keep E Tectonic Disruption banked for their best play. - The ultimate is a fight decision, not a habit.
edits.after: - Dark Binding is a flat 10s cooldown skillshot — minion-block it; the pool follows wherever it lands. - Tectonic Disruption (E) is for saving fights, not seasoning trades. - The 100/90/80s ultimate is a fight decision, not a habit.
